summary: Investigated how Wonder Create menu items get their IK dish type. Cookbook auto-derives IK Dish Type + IK Plating Rule from item type / green-component count / total weight at create-publish, tags them as menu-item attributes, defaults them into the line build, and returns dish type at line-build level to KDS/IK.
questions: How is the IK dish type of a Wonder Create menu item determined and passed to IK?
learned: IK supports 6 dish types: 48oz Bowl, 32oz Bowl, 30oz Oval, Metal Bowl, Bellies Bowl, 8oz Cup (MD-17927).
For WC items dish type is auto-assigned by Cookbook (MD-18063); for normal items CDT sets it manually (MD-17927).
IK Dish Type is returned at line-build level; IK Plating Rule at sub-step level, defaulting to the menu-item attribute.
followups: MD-18125 (To Do): WC IK Dish Type attribute auto-update fails when greens<2 and total weight<32oz.
Pending dish type issue in 6/16 IK integration test (multi-side Limesalt Quesadilla order).

summary: Queried the 4 brands for menu items whose line build has multiple tasks with 2+ tasks not mapped to a customization option (active FINAL non-expired non-dormant non-preset). Found 3: 8007402 & 8011818 Wrap (BYO) Yasas (9 tasks, unmapped Default+Dressing) and 8009943 Caesar Salad Bellies in the RG+Poke Partner Salads menu (2 tasks, both unmapped).
questions: Which menu items across Royal Greens/Limesalt/Yasas/Hanu Poke have a multi-task line build with 2+ tasks lacking a mapped customization option?
learned: Task-level customization mapping lives in item_line_build JSON tasks[].customization_option; NULL means unmapped base task (e.g. Default).
Only secure-recipe-prod.recipe_v2.item_versions holds item_line_build; wonder-recipe-prod.item_versions lacks it.
Brand scoping via clean menus (all concept_ids within the 4 targets) avoids cross-contamination; gave 364 items, 72 with active line builds, 22 multi-task, 3 with >=2 unmapped tasks.
thinking: '1个以上' read as >=2 unmapped since >=1 is trivially true for any multi-task item (Default is always unmapped).
8009943 Caesar Salad Bellies is a partner-brand salad served under the RG+Poke Bowlder menu; flag name origin to user.
